raw_response: {"diagnosis":"silver_transactions has a filter `ingest_ts - txn_ts <= 26 HOUR` that silently drops late-arriving POSTED transactions. From batch 3 on, about 80 rows per batch carry txn_ts roughly 3 days before ingest. txn_id is unique, so removing the filter creates no duplicates, and txn_date is derived from txn_ts, so late rows land on their correct business day.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.7,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
